context_filter.H1: Last expected UTC H1 already closed; require complete60M1 and direction*(close-open)>0; never reuse older complete H1
context_filter.ADX: TA-Lib ADX14 on last closed complete M5; require >=25; strength only, H1 body supplies directional condition
context_filter.ADX_gap_policy: Reset seed on every missing M5; no interpolation or gap-skipping
context_filter.missing_value: Explicit UNKNOWN filter refusal, no zero replacement
context_filter.threshold_status: Single conventional25 threshold fixed without PnL-by-indicator search
context_filter.H1_EMA20_excluded: Preliminary availability check0/61 entries and0/202breakouts; not used or retuned to conceal missing warmup

level_veto.family: Strict H1 fractals2left2right, all5H1 complete, known only at second right close
level_veto.lookback: Confirmations in preceding24 clock hours, including exactlyt-24h
level_veto.revisit: Executable bid high for resistance / ask low for support touched at or beyond level during [known_at,t), excludes level as already visited
level_veto.observation_gap: If not observed touched but a minute is missing in [known_at,t), freshness UNKNOWN
level_veto.execution_guard: At actual first entry quote, known opposing INTACT level ahead of bid_open for BUY or ask_open for SELL and before or exactly at planned2R target refuses; corresponding UNKNOWN level separately refuses
level_veto.no_level_found: No identified veto, not proof there are no barriers or that level will reverse price
level_veto.partial_daily_levels: Not used: exact previous NY17day unavailable; no invented extrema

continuation.denominator: Only actual TP exits of each newly replayed2R portfolio, separately by cost
continuation.source: Same entry, original stop, same quantity and cost convention; independent hypothetical per-trade extension, not portfolio
continuation.horizon: Original16h Europe/London hard exit; no overnight continuation or break-even change
continuation.fill_rule: Executable bid/ask, one-tick target penetration, original stop priority if both reachable sameM1, deadline open before that row high/low
continuation.same_minute: Threshold reached in TP2 M1 separately labelled SAME_M1_AS_2R; not claimed strictly after2R fill
continuation.missing_path: Unknown not a failure;3R known reached remains known if4R subsequently unknown

decision_criteria: Compare full portfolios, positions and pauses, not deletion of old losses
Fewer absolute losses with drastically fewer trades is not by itself an improvement
Evidence of development improvement requires lower lossrate and higher net in BOTH cost cases versus corresponding2R witness
Below20 closed trades interpretation remains insufficient, regardless of percentage
No automatic promotion, parameter search,80pct or FTMOpass claim; stop after this finite comparison
charts: Use actual historical candlesticks,ADX and only entry-known H1 levels; render post-exit prices separately; illustrative selections do not choose filters
